zh.title: 德軍退役C-160D運輸機將改裝為裝甲滅火機
zh.summary: TAS計劃於2027年啟用首架退役C-160D改裝滅火機
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，總部位於德國下薩克森邦的 Total Aeronautical Services (TAS) 計劃將兩架自德國空軍退役的 Transall C-160D 運輸機改裝為消防滅火機。首架改裝機已被分配民用航空註冊號 D-AMJT，預計於 2027 年夏季野火季投入營運，並獲得德國聯邦航空局（LBA）和德國聯邦國防軍採購局（BAAINBw）的支持。
該機將保留軍役時期配備的 Kevlar 防彈裝甲，以便在含有未爆彈的演習場等高風險區域滅火。改裝使用貨艙內的 Helitak 水箱，可攜帶約 14 噸水或阻燃劑，並透過機腹以每秒 3000 公升的速度排放。

en.title: Retired German Luftwaffe Transall C-160D Airlifters to Return as Armored Firefighting Aircraft
en.summary: TAS plans to deploy the first converted C-160D for the 2027 wildfire season.
body: According to AeroTime, Germany-based Total Aeronautical Services (TAS) is preparing two retired German Air Force Transall C-160D airlifters to return to service as firefighting aircraft. The operator aims to have the first aircraft, allocated registration D-AMJT, operational for the summer 2027 wildfire season with support from Germany's Federal Aviation Office (LBA) and Bundeswehr procurement agency BAAINBw.

The converted aircraft will retain Kevlar armor from their military service to allow operations over ground contaminated by unexploded ordnance, where ground crews cannot safely enter. The firefighting system features an internal Helitak tank in the cargo hold carrying approximately 14 tonnes of water or retardant, discharging through the belly at up to 3,000 liters per second.
